rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for giving or receiving an injection, including injecting drugs.

example.english: The nurse is going to inject me.
example.jyutping: wu6 si6 bong1 ngo5 daa2 zam1

rows.note: Use this when physically forcing or pumping a liquid into a vessel, cavity, or passage.

example.english: They used a syringe to inject the medicine into the tube.
example.traditional: 佢哋用針筒將藥水打入條喉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 zam1 tung2 zoeng1 joek6 seoi2 daa2 jap6 tiu4 hau4

rows.note: Use this for suddenly infusing an abstract quality, force, or feeling into a situation.

example.english: This speech helped inject new energy into the event.
example.traditional: 呢場演講為活動注入新動力。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 jin2 gong2 wai6 wut6 dung6 zyu3 jap6 san1 dung6 lik6

rows.note: Use this when adding a distinct or foreign element into a system, place, or process.

example.english: They decided to inject a new element into the system.
example.traditional: 佢哋決定將新元素加入系統。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 san1 jyun4 sou3 gaa1 jap6 hai6 tung2
